The control room for your screens

Xtravu exists to take the chaos out of managing displays across more than one location — one dashboard, one app, every screen accounted for.

What Xtravu actually does

Xtravu is a SaaS platform for digital signage — a control dashboard paired with an Android app, built so anyone managing screens across multiple sites can do it without visiting each one.

The dashboard is where the decisions happen: upload your video and image content, build it into playlists, arrange it into custom layouts, and decide which screen or group of screens should show it and when. The Android app is what actually lives on each display — install it on any Android device and it quietly pulls whatever you've assigned, plays it on schedule, and reports back so the dashboard always knows what's live.

Together, they cover the whole job of running a screen network: getting content out, keeping it current, and being able to see at a glance that everything is actually showing what it's supposed to. That's the gap Xtravu is built to close — not just displaying content, but managing it at whatever scale your business operates at.

The businesses that get the most out of Xtravu are the ones with more than one screen to think about — restaurant chains coordinating menu boards across branches, retailers running in-store promotions, corporate teams managing lobby and meeting-room displays, or any organisation where "update the screen" used to mean sending someone out with a USB stick.

What we focus on

A few things matter more than the rest when you're building software that other people's screens depend on every day.

Reliability over features

A screen that goes blank at the wrong moment costs more than a missing feature ever will. Xtravu is built so playback keeps running even when a connection drops.

Simplicity for non-technical teams

You shouldn't need a developer to change what's on a screen. The dashboard is built for marketing and ops teams to use directly, day to day.

Scale without complexity

The same account that manages one screen manages a thousand. Adding locations shouldn't mean adding a new layer of process.

Standard hardware, no lock-in

Xtravu runs on Android devices you can source yourself. There's no proprietary box you're forced to buy to use the platform.

How it works once you're set up

Getting a screen network onto Xtravu follows the same pattern whether you have three screens or three hundred.

1

Register your screens

Install the Android app on each display and it appears in your dashboard, ready to be assigned content.

2

Build your content

Upload video and images, arrange them into playlists, and design layouts for screens that need more than one thing showing at once.

3

Schedule and assign

Decide what plays where and when — by screen, by group, or across your whole network — and let the schedule run itself.

4

Monitor from the dashboard

Check in on any screen, anywhere, to confirm it's online and playing what it should be — without leaving your desk.

Bring your screens onto one dashboard

Tell us about your network — how many screens, how many locations — and we'll show you how Xtravu fits it.

Control every screen, anywhere, from one dashboard

Xtravu is the dashboard and Android app that turns scattered TVs and displays into one managed network — push content, schedule what plays, and know exactly what's live, right now.

Book a demo

One dashboard. Every screen. No guesswork.

If you're running screens across more than one location — a kitchen counter, a storefront window, a lobby, a franchise network — you already know the pain of keeping them all showing the right thing.

Xtravu gives you a single control panel for every Android display you own, wherever it's plugged in. Upload a video, drop it into a playlist, and push it to one screen or five hundred — the dashboard handles the rest, and the Android app on each device just quietly plays what it's told, when it's told.

It's built for the people who actually have to keep screens running day to day: marketing teams juggling seasonal promos, ops managers covering a multi-site chain, and IT staff who'd rather not drive to every location to swap a USB stick. If that's you, this is the tool that gets your time back.

What you get

Four pieces that work together, so your screens stay current without anyone physically touching them.

A dashboard that sees everything

Every screen in your network shows up in one place — what's playing, whether it's online, and when it last checked in. No more guessing what's actually on display at a site you're not standing in.

The Android app that just plays

Install it on any Android device and it becomes a managed screen. Video, images, playlists — it pulls exactly what you've assigned it and keeps playing, even if the connection drops for a moment.

Playlists and scheduling

Line up your content once and let it run — different playlists for morning and evening, a promo that switches on for the weekend, a menu that updates itself. Set it and move on.

Layouts built your way

Split a screen into zones — video on one side, a live menu or ticker on the other — without needing a designer or a developer every time you want to change the arrangement.

Trusted by teams running screens at scale

Xtravu is running behind the counters and lobbies of brands including Pizza Hut, Burger Singh, McDonald's, ITC, and Meta — organisations that can't afford a screen going dark or showing the wrong thing.

Whether you're managing five screens or five hundred, the same dashboard scales with you. See everything it includes or Get a quote for your setup.

Why teams choose Xtravu

Built for networks, not single screens

Manage one screen or your whole estate from the same login. Nothing about the dashboard changes as you add more locations.

Runs on Android hardware you can already buy

No proprietary players to source. If it runs Android, the Xtravu app can turn it into a managed screen.

Pricing that scales with your screen count

Costs are per screen, starting from 5k per screen, so what you pay reflects the size of your network — not a flat licence fee regardless of use.

Proven with brands that can't afford downtime

Chains and enterprises with hundreds of locations already run their screens on Xtravu — it's built to hold up under that kind of pressure.

Everything you need to run a screen network, in one place

One dashboard. One app. Every screen you own, doing exactly what you told it to, whether that's one till-side display or five hundred stores.

What's included

No bundles to decode, no hidden modules. This is what you're actually buying when you sign up with Xtravu.

Dashboard - Control Panel

Log in from any browser and see every screen you manage — what's playing, whether it's online, when it last checked in. Push new content to one screen or a thousand without leaving your desk, and stop finding out about a blank display from a customer instead of your own dashboard.

Android App - Screen Playback

Install the Xtravu app on any Android device or Android-powered TV and it becomes a signage player — no proprietary box to buy, no specialist to install it. Point it at a screen, connect it to your account, and it's live.

Content Playlists & Scheduling

Build a playlist once and let it run itself: breakfast menu at 7am, lunch specials at noon, an evening promo, a festive takeover on the days you choose. Set the schedule and stop manually swapping content by hand.

Custom Layouts

Split a screen into zones — a menu on one side, a video loop or live feed on the other, a ticker running underneath. Design the layout that suits the space, rather than being stuck with one image filling one screen.

Per-Screen Pricing

Straightforward, scaled to your network. You're not paying for a platform license you don't need — you're paying for the screens you actually run.

How it works

Getting a screen network live doesn't need an IT rollout. Here's the actual path from first login to content on the wall.

1

Set up your dashboard

Create your account and you're looking at your control panel — empty for now, but ready for every screen you add to it.

2

Connect your screens

Install the Android app on each device you want to use as a display, and pair it with your dashboard. That screen now shows up as one you control.

3

Build your content and layout

Upload video, images, and playlists, and arrange them into the layout that suits each screen — one zone or several.

4

Schedule it

Decide what plays when, across which screens, and let the schedule run without you touching it again.

5

Go live and monitor

Watch every screen's status from the same dashboard, and push updates to your whole network the moment something needs to change.

Questions people ask before signing up

Do I need special hardware to display content?

No. If you have an Android device or Android-powered TV, the Xtravu app turns it into a signage player. There's no proprietary box to source or install.

Can I manage screens across more than one location?

Yes — that's the point of the dashboard. Whether your screens are in one shop or spread across a chain of them, they all show up in the same control panel, and content can be pushed to any of them from anywhere.

What happens if a screen goes offline?

The dashboard shows you its status, so you'll know a screen has dropped off the network rather than finding out when a customer mentions it. It keeps playing its last loaded content locally where possible, and syncs again once it's back online.

How is pricing worked out?

Per screen — starting from 5k per screen. There's no separate platform fee bolted on top; the cost scales with how many screens you're actually running.
